ios.desc:
AI Hairstyler lets you preview new hairstyles and hair colors on your own photo in seconds. Upload a clear selfie, pick a style, and see a realistic try-on instantly — before your next salon visit.

**What you can do**

- Try popular haircuts and hairstyles (short, medium, long, curly, wavy, and more)
- Test hair colors on your photo (natural tones or bold shades)
- Choose **real brand shades** to match your next dye
- Pick **any custom color** with the color picker
- Export in the right size: **Story (9:16), Feed, Square**, and more
- Save results in **HD** and share anywhere

**Get better results**

Use a front-facing, high-resolution photo and avoid accessories like hats or sunglasses for the cleanest try-on.

**Made for**

- Anyone planning a haircut or hair color change
- Finding what hairstyle suits you before committing
- Quick inspiration for your next look

Try new hairstyles, test hair colors, and find your next look with AI — fast, simple, and fun.
